source_policy: Exact source file and normalized text hashes are preserved.
One repeated authority (REV-700/1994) is retained as provenance alias only and is not re-canonicalized.
Entry 156 is preserved as one compound publication headnote citing REV-623/1993 and REV-624/1993.
The REV-624/1993 collision with B10 is an unresolved source conflict, not a duplicate; no record is overwritten or merged.
Source-document numbering conflicts for entries 154/155 and Collection V locators 155/155-A are preserved explicitly.
OLE title anomalies in 6.doc and 6-a.doc are preserved without silent correction.
The internal date conflict in 150.doc is preserved without silent correction.
Every item is historical and requires current-law verification before present-law reliance.
Collection V binding does not equal remote/original-decision binding.
No ECLI, URL, later treatment, current-law status or binding force is invented.
